main.description: What is directly under a node. `children` is every child of either kind as a light row, which is what a drawer expands by; `documents` is the child documents whole, for a page that shows what its children say (a resolution's amendments, a position's candidates). Serves only what the caller may read.

profiles.description: An object from DID to profileView, for everyone the rows name by DID: each child's creator, each document's authors.
